description.value: Wildside Grill is a casual West Coast restaurant located within Tofino's Live to Surf complex along the Pacific Rim Highway, celebrating Vancouver Island's seasonal bounty with a menu spanning burgers, fish and chips, seafood, and Mexican dishes. It draws steady crowds and offers a call-ahead option to skip the line — a practical perk for cyclists on a schedule. Touring riders on the Pacific Rim route will find it a well-positioned fuel stop near the edge of town.

address.value: 1180 Pacific Rim Highway, Tofino, BC V0R2Z0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is open and operating at 1180 Pacific Rim Highway in Tofino's Live to Surf complex, with a matching phone number and address. No amenity evidence (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields remain null.
